title: Live status overlay (optional asset kind 'live', sli/1.6+)
description: Status observations from the live-status lane since the last full feed, during match hours. Readers overlay each entry on the day assets by event id when its status_observed_at is newer than the event's, then apply the manifest's compatibility.live_state_rule. Since 1.7, and only for sources the owner approved for scores, a row may carry the live or final score. No programme data.

generated_at.description: The newest observation in this asset

id.description: Event id in the same feed revision's day assets

status_normalized.description: scheduled | live | finished | postponed | cancelled | unknown

live_until_utc.description: 0.3.24+: with status live, show LIVE only until this time

display_state.description: Optional (contract 4.5): the display state as of this row's build; replaces the event's published display_state when this row is newer

finished_at_utc.description: Optional: present with display_state finished when the final status was read from a source

score.description: 1.7+, optional: the live score (status live: show it only while LIVE holds) or a final score read after the event; only while the manifest has compatibility.scores.enabled. home is the score of participants[0], away of participants[1] (positional, not the home/away role); ignore when the event does not have exactly two participants. No minute. Absent means unknown, never 0-0.

period.description: 1H HT 2H ET PEN FT AET Q1-Q4 P1-P3 OT, or null; unknown values: treat as null

source.description: SportsLiveInfo source id, one of rights.scores.approved_sources
